reviews.decision_reason: map_coverage preserves the allowed record window and correctly marks exact capability matches as direct while leaving missing capability matches unsupported; the observed coverage rows reflect that behavior.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: preserve exact handoff needs into coverage
avoid fabricating demand from unrelated capability matches

reviews.decision_reason: prioritize_needs inverts the unsupported flag by setting unsupported = coverage == 'direct'. This ranks covered/direct records before actually unsupported records, contradicting the boundary role and producing the behaviorally significant wrong top priority.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: rank unsupported needs before covered needs
preserve visible contradiction between coverage and unsupported flags

reviews.decision_reason: synthesize_recommendation keeps the eight-item priority window and deterministically builds the recommendation from the first ranked record. Its wrong final top_need is downstream of the suspect priority ordering, not an independent synthesis fault.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: construct recommendation from already-ranked first priority record

reviews.decision_reason: select_demand_records preserves all eight supplied corpus records under the explicit score/fallback rule. The package does not provide independent market-demand observations, so demand quality itself cannot be strengthened here, but the transformation matches its declared role.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: select demanded corpus rows while preserving fallback path
establish real customer demand beyond supplied background records

reviews.decision_reason: normalize_evidence reindexes to required columns, applies neutral missing-field sentinels, restricts to the allowed record IDs, and retains the eight-row window. No contradictory output is visible for this boundary.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: preserve missing or contradictory evidence visibly

reviews.decision_reason: assemble_provenance builds ranked evidence-source rows from normalized needs using demand_score ordering. Its ranks are handed off exactly to downstream, so it is not the root cause of the final incorrect priority order.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: build ranked provenance from normalized needs
preserve exact handoff evidence source records
